subject: Web Development
title: Web Components and Standards
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Web Components and Standards.

hook.text: Every framework invented its own way to create reusable UI pieces.

buildup.text: Web Components offered a browser-native solution with custom elements and Shadow DOM.

discovery.text: Developers could create encapsulated, reusable widgets without any framework.

twist.text: React and Vue moved faster. Web Components arrived too late to stop the framework wars.

climax.text: But standards outlast hype. Web Components are now supported in every major browser.

punchline.text: Standards move slow but last forever.

quiz.question: What browser feature do Web Components use for encapsulation?
